description: Write a ready-to-use folder for game engines: several WAV variations of one preset (or several seamless loops), a Godot 4 AudioStreamRandomizer (.tres, plays a random variation each time), a Unity SfxBrewPlayer.cs component, a plain Web Audio .js player and a README. Loop WAVs carry a loop point that Godot, FMOD, Wwise and GameMaker read. Writes <out_dir>/sfxbrew-<preset>/. For Godot, out_dir should be the project root (res://) so the .tres paths resolve.

count.description: Number of variations (default 8) or loops (default 2, max 6)

loop_seconds.description: Make seamless loops of about this many seconds. Only for: rain, wind, campfire, stream, drum, caveDrip, thunder, chime, monsterGrowl

out_dir.description: Directory to create the sfxbrew-<preset> folder in, e.g. "." for a Godot project root or "Assets/Audio" for Unity

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; variation i uses seed + i

name: export_pack
title: Export a game-engine sound pack
